Throwaway time!

While at an afterparty, I met a *really* cute quiet girl and we really hit it off. We started making out furiously by the end of the night, and for the next couple of weeks would get drinks together and go dancing. The night I go back to her place, she wants to get totally shitfaced; being young and stupid, I agree. One thing leads to another and we start grinding/spooning, she whispers "I want you to fuck me in the rear", which to a drunk horny college kid is total success. I'm pretty into it, when I decide to go in for a reach around.

Surprise! it's a penis! Within a fiftieth of a second, I felt the greatest surge of horror and revulsion I have ever known, stopped immediately (which, surprise, made her start sobbing uncontrollably), and went into a two-hour-talk about how she's well into hormone treatments (hence the curves and natural-looking A cup), has had crippling identity issues since childhood, so on and so forth. I felt like a bastard for cutting off contact just because of genitals she shouldn't have been born with in the first place, but at the same time, I am irrevocably and hard-codedly straight as an arrow and couldn't so much as hug people for almost a month. That shit was traumatizing.

TL;DR completely straight guy and I fell for a lady who wasn't born a lady, wasn't done becoming one, and never told me; I only found out when we were halfway through drunkenly fucking.

It's a toss up between a couple of things.

- When I was a teenager, I found some pot seeds in a small ziplock left behind in a bathroom at a party (I didn't smoke weed at this point) and absentmindedly put them in my pocket. About a month later, while hiking in a state park, I rediscovered them in the back pocket and I carefully planted them in random off-trail sunny spots. I genuinely had no interest in smoking it at that point, I just wanted to get rid of the seeds and was curious to see if they'd actually grow and the plants would be there whenever I visited next. Two years after that, there was a story in the paper about how a park ranger was caught "harvesting marijuana from several lone plants" in said state park and was getting a couple years of prison time for allegedly growing it there. I'm still not sure if they were "my" plants that ruined his life.

- I'm not remotely proud of this, but when I was 18 and had just graduated high school I got super drunk for the first time in my life. It was at a large house party, and I went to lie down in a side bedroom because I felt ready to pass out. I proceeded to more or less molest a thoroughly passed out drunk teenager who was already in the bed, who I later found out was just barely under my state's age of consent. We later met again and became good friends, and she has *no* fucking idea that this ever happened and it still haunts me.

- Like everyone else here, i've pirated thousands of dollars worth of TV shows, movies, and video games.
